data.job_details:
Looking for a mid-senior Bitrix24 Developer

You have:

  • Profound expertise in 1C-Bitrix/Bitrix24, particularly in on-premise Bitrix24, and adept at integrating with CRM entity cards and smart processes.
  • Comprehensive understanding of built-in Bitrix24 functionalities, including Tasks, Groups, Notifications, Drive, and CRM.
  • Over 3 years of web development experience with PHP 7+ (Laravel, Symfony) and MySQL.
  • Possession of 1C-Bitrix certificates/exams.
  • Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript (React, Vue), and jQuery.
  • Proven track record in developing custom functionality, such as modules, components, controllers, and integrating with third-party APIs.
  • Experience in seamlessly integrating with information systems through Webhooks and REST API.
  • Skilful in code refactoring, including third-party and existing code.
  • Competent in utilizing version control systems, particularly GIT.
  • Capability to write and document code meticulously.
  • Solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and relational databases.
  • Logical thinking abilities and a strong desire to continue learning and improving.
     

Responsibilities:

  • Implementing new modules, components, extensions, and applications to enhance business processes within the on-premises version of Bitrix24.
  • Fine-tuning and advancing existing modules and components.
  • Crafting software solutions on the Bitrix platform, including CRM, the internal corporate portal, and HR functions.
  • Creating novel subsystems and tools for business process automation.
  • Debugging source code errors and preparing new software releases.
  • Providing support and driving the development of on-premises Bitrix24.
  • Developing new functionality and improving existing Bitrix24 modules.
  • Integrating with external information systems and developing integration services.
  • Crafting a customized interface for new functionality within Bitrix24.
  • Implementing smart processes and connecting to or creating JavaScript events.
  • Engaging with backend events and developing your own backend events.

What we offer: (help of our HR team to fill-in) 

  • Official employment in accordance with the Labour Code of the United Arab Emirates
  • Paid UAE Employment Visa arranged and covered.
  • Paid Health insurance arranged and covered.
  • Working hours: 5/2 from 09:00 -18:00 UAE time, possible shift by an hour in any direction;
  • Remote/office work format.
  • Payment for vacation and official sick leave is made in accordance with the Labour Code of the UAE of 22 working days;
